findings.title: Light-theme value changed from 30% to 70% (typo in dark-light-choose)
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new light-theme branch is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, paired with `$secondary 30%`. This silently makes `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` much lighter on light themes, a visual regression in an otherwise dark-mode-only change. The light value should remain 30% and the dark value should be 70%, i.e. `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: `.group-member-info .name` light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The original color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. It was replaced with the 50%/50% pair, which changes the light-theme color and makes the name as dim as the title. The matching pair for 30% should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The same regression is repeated in mobile/user.scss.

findings.title: `.group-member-info .name` light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The replacement uses 50%/50%, so the light-theme appearance changes unintentionally and the name loses its emphasis over the title. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: `.topic-map h3` light-theme lightness changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new value is the 50%/50% pair, which unintentionally lightens the topic-map heading on light themes and weakens the hierarchy against `h4`, which is also 50%. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`, matching the desktop version.

findings.title: `.custom-message-length` light-theme lightness changed from 70% to 30%
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. The new light branch is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` with the dark branch at `$secondary 70%`, so the pairs are swapped. On light themes the text becomes much darker than before, and on dark themes the lightness is inconsistent with the desktop equivalent, which uses 70%/30%. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: `#file-uploading` still uses `$secondary` lightness, unhandled for light themes
findings.body: `#file-uploading` colors the text with `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)` and is not wrapped in `dark-light-choose`. The text is mid-grey derived from `$secondary` and is likely hard to read on dark themes, the very problem this PR targets, and is inconsistent with the rest of the changes. The change is incomplete there.
